name: Is a smooth drywall finish better than a textured finish for a basement?

mainEntity.name: Is a smooth drywall finish better than a textured finish for a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smooth drywall walls provide a modern look but show flaws more easily, whereas textured walls hide minor imperfections and offer greater durability against daily wear. Smooth finishes require more extensive labor, precise sanding, and often a skim coat to prevent joints from photographing through the paint. Texturing, such as orange peel or knockdown, adds a subtle surface pattern that easily blends seam lines and resists visible scuffs. However, textured walls are more difficult to patch seamlessly if wall repairs are needed later. Homeowners balancing budget and aesthetics often choose a light knockdown or orange peel finish for finished basements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smooth walls offer a modern aesthetic but require more labor and show flaws. Textured finishes disguise minor framing imperfections and cost less to execute.
